chapter: Split, hospital and decline of tap
title: Dancers who changed careers: Cagney, MacMurray, Condos
summary: Green says tap dancers moved to other work, naming James Cagney, Fred MacMurray, Frank Condos as a policeman, and George Jessel and Lou Holtz.
